title: YouTuber Joe Is Hungry says he never expected his KFC Popcorn Chicken review to go viral
summary_full: Food reviewer Joe Is Hungry expressed surprise at his KFC Popcorn Chicken video's popularity.  The video garnered nearly twenty million views across various social media platforms.  Joe admitted he did not anticipate such widespread attention for the review.  He also discussed the challenges involved in creating his unique food review videos.  His distinctive filming style and honest reactions continue to attract a large audience.
